name: Nelsya
title: Sentry

guard/30348.htm.text: Sentry Nelsya: Pleased to meet you. I am Sentry Nelsya, in charge of this village's public order. This cave leads to the Dark Elven village located within the large mountain before you. We came here a long time ago, due to pressure from other races, and built this place with our blood and tears.
guard/30348.htm.dpText: Sentry Nelsya: Pleased to meet you. I am Sentry Nelsya, in charge of this village's public order. The cave behind me leads to the underground Dark Elf Village. This place is the last home town of the Dark Elves, built with our blood and tears.

links.text: See the Lord and get the tax rate information.
